source.clean_tree_checks: runner refusal before the run and HEAD/tree/status checks after each cell all passed

build.note: Both commands ran once before the first cell; each cell's identical runner build was then a no-op.

execution.host_lock: An outer flock held the shared host lock from before the build until after the last cell. RUSTBGPD_HOST_LOCK pointed each runner invocation's own exclusive lock at a campaign-private file, because a second open of the held shared lock file would conflict with the outer holder.
execution.scheduling_wait: Before each cell the campaign waited, up to one hour, for no cargo/rustc/rustbgpd/reloadstall/perf/rrharness/bgperf process and a one-minute load below 1.8. Every wait succeeded. The runner's own prebuild/postbuild preflight then gated unchanged.
execution.runner_preflight: All 20 runner preflight rows passed: load 1.52-1.77, 64/64 performance governors, no competitors, zero swap-in/out, free ports, at least 100 GiB available memory.
execution.foreign_process_samples: The 1 Hz wrapper competitor sample saw one cargo process 1.6 s after cold convergence in a-off-r1 (after its transient peak) and the runner's own no-op cargo before daemon start in f-1000x400-1048576. No cell was excluded.
execution.exclusions: none; every cell ran once and is reported
execution.cleanup: Every runner removed its runtime directory; all scopes, daemon and harness processes exited; ports 1790/9179 were free after the campaign.

memory_method.primary: daemon cgroup memory.peak. Each cell ran in a transient delegated user scope with MemorySwapMax=0, split into runner/ and daemon/ leaf cgroups. A 10 ms watcher moved the measured daemon (not its --check invocation) into daemon/ with memory.swap.max=0 as soon as it appeared.
memory_method.uncounted_startup: Memory charged before the move stays in runner/. RssAnon at the move was 5.0-5.2 MiB for two-peer cells and 14.9-17.6 MiB for 1,000-peer cells (cells.csv).
memory_method.secondary: runner-recorded settled /proc VmRSS and VmHWM, 1 Hz process-tree RSS median after convergence, and jemalloc allocated/resident gauges from the settled metrics scrape.
memory_method.harness: runner/ peak includes the reloadstall harness, samplers and the no-op build; it is reported separately as harness_cgroup_peak_bytes.

campaign.sh.published_differences: local output and worktree paths became required BASE/WT inputs, the private scope-unit prefix became explain-cache-, and the wrapper is found beside the script
